description.value:
The Nantambu Chime-Ringers created these magical chimes to aid in their defense of their city. Each chime is made from elaborately carved wood depicting the nature of a given chime's power.

- **Activate:** 2 Actions

You ring the chime, unleashing its magic. The specifics of each chime, as well as the activation's frequency (if any), appear in its entry below.

This chime's carvings depict skulls and other grim icons.

When activated, it creates an aura of fear in a 5-foot emanation for 1 round. Creatures in the aura must attempt a DC 27 Will save. On a failure, they become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). Affected creatures can't reduce their frightened condition below frightened 1 while the chime is ringing. You can Sustain the Activation to sustain the aura, up to a total of 5 rounds. This chime can be used only once per day, whether or not you Sustain the aura.
